title: AI Solutions Architect | Technical Delivery
summary: AI solutions architect with 15+ years spanning software delivery, QA leadership, enterprise platforms, and automation. Founded a consultancy delivering 120+ GenAI applications for 30+ clients and led enterprise AI work at Assent that delivered $1.7M+ in savings and increased internal adoption from 47% to 97%. Combines hands-on production architecture with stakeholder coordination, resource and budget management, and a delivery background in banking systems.
